title: Nyang Jaga Panen Rahsia .
intro: Bak saboh nanggroe nyang ijo, saboh kelompok ureueng geupeugot saboh rencana rahasia dimiyub tutup seupôt. Awaknyan na tujuan nyang saban, teuma niet awaknyan jiôh nibak nyang beutôi. Hana jiteupeue lé awaknyan bahwa na liku-liku ilahi nyang teungoh jipreh awaknyan watée awaknyan teungoh teungeut.
clues: Kamoe peugot saboh tekad nyang teuga, kamoe pike rencana kamoe hana cacat.
Kamoe meukeusud keuneuk teubiet awai, sigohlom gob pih ka meu-ulang-ulang.
Kamoe meu-ulang-ulang bak saboh tanoh nyang subur, yakin keu beukai kamoe.
Bak watèë kamoë trôh u teumpat njang kamoë tujuan, kamoë meurumpok deungon tan dan seupôt, maka kamoë pike kamoë ka gadôh rot.
Teuma kamoë sadar bahwa njan beutôi-beutôi teumpat kamoë, dan kamoë meu-ulang-ulang deungon putôh asa, saleng meusalah ateuëh rugoë kamoë.

Kamoë ka meusumpah beungoh njan untôk peuteubiët ureuëng gasien nibak hasé panen kamoë, tapi hukôman Allah teuka ateuëh kamoë watèë kamoë teungoh teungeut, djipeu-ubah taman kamoë djeuët keu runtuhan.

trial.label: Sidang kamoe
options: Taman geutanyoe ka jipeureuloh lé bala dari langèt .
Taman kamoe geusampoe le ie raya .
Taman kamoe ka tutong le apui dari musoh .
Taman kamoe peunoh ngon balang .

trial.answer: Taman geutanyoe ka jipeureuloh lé bala dari langèt .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Kamoe meusumpah kamoe cok boh jih bak beungoh uroe .
Kamoe peugot ampéh keu meuië keu taman kamoë .
Kamoe meulindong lam guha keu lindông .
Kamoe meusiab saboh teuntra keu meujak reubot saboh keurajeuen .
Kamoe meulayeue kapai keu meujeumeurang laôt .
location.answer: Kamoe meusumpah kamoe cok boh jih bak beungoh uroe .

outcome.label: Nasib Geutanyoe
options: Ta taubat ta harap rahmat bak Allah .
Kamoe banmandum hanco dan hántom kamoe meutobat .
Kamoe plueng nibak nanggroe nyan dan hana le kamoe woe .
Geutanyoe jeuet keu kuasa dan kaya lom .
Kamoe geuhukom deungon geu ubah jeut keu monyet .
outcome.answer: Ta taubat ta harap rahmat bak Allah .

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
